meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以调用浏览器自动化命令,替你打开网址、点击页面元素、填写表单、截图、提取页面信息等。它通过截取页面快照获取可操作元素,并用引用编号操作它们。
howto.when: 当你需要浏览网页、填写表单、截图、测试网页应用或从网页提取信息时。只要涉及网页操作,Claude 就会用这个技能。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并告诉我页面标题
say.note: Claude 会打开网址并返回标题

say.text: 在表单里填写邮箱 user@test.com 并提交
say.note: Claude 会定位输入框填入并点击提交

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run browser automation commands to open URLs, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, and extract page info. It captures page snapshots to find interactive elements and operate them via refs like @e1.
howto.when_en: When the user needs to browse websites, fill forms, take screenshots, test web apps, or extract info from pages.

say_en.text: Open example.com and tell me the page title
say_en.note: Claude opens the site and returns the title

say_en.text: Fill the form with email user@test.com and submit
say_en.note: Claude locates the inputs, fills, and clicks submit

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of the current page
